sql.schedule.getEventsByProject: select p.id, p.project_name, c.id as contact_id, c.phone, c.mobile, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(steps))) FROM ( SELECT ps.process_step_name as "processStepName", pps.id as "projectProcessStepId", ps.id as "processStepId", pse.id as "processStepEventId", pse.event_id as "eventId", e.event_name as "eventName", ppse.id as "projectProcessStepEventId", pps.company_process_step_status_type_id as "companyProcessStepStatusTypeId", cpsst.process_step_status_type as "processStepStatusType", cpsst.process_step_status_type_id as "processStepStatusTypeId", ppse.start_time as start, ppse.start_time as "end", case when sl.system_list_type_id = 1 then o.org_name else concat(u.first_name, ' ', u.last_name) end as "resourceName" from flow.project_process_step_event ppse inner join flow.process_step_event pse on ppse.process_step_event_id = pse.id inner join flow.event e on pse.event_id = e.id inner join flow.project_process_step pps on pps.id = ppse.project_process_step_id inner join flow.process_step ps on pps.process_step_id = ps.id inner join flow.company_process_step_status_type cpsst on cpsst.id = pps.company_process_step_status_type_id inner join flow.custom_field cf on cf.id = e.resource_custom_field_id left join flow.user_position up on up.id = ppse.resource_id left join flow.user u on u.id = up.user_id left join flow.org o on o.id = ppse.resource_id inner join flow.company_system_list csl on csl.id = cf.company_system_list_id inner join flow.system_list sl on sl.id = csl.system_list_id where pps.project_id = :projectId and pps.archived is not true and pps.main is true order by start, "end" ) steps), '[]') AS "events" from flow.project p inner join flow.contact c on p.contact_id = c.id where p.id = :projectId and p.archived is false

event_id, sl.system_list_type_id, ppse.start_time as start, ppse.end_time as "end", ppse.resource_id as resource_id, u.id as user_id, c.id as contact_id, c.first_name as contact_first_name, cpsst.process_step_status_type, cpsst.process_step_status_type_id from flow.project_process_step pps inner join flow.project_process_step_event ppse on pps.id = ppse.project_process_step_id inner join flow.process_step_event pse on ppse.process_step_event_id = pse.id inner join flow.event e on pse.event_id = e.id inner join flow.project p on p.id = pps.project_id inner join flow.company_project_status_type cpst on cpst.id = p.company_project_status_type_id inner join flow.process_step ps on ps.id = pps.process_step_id inner join flow.company_process_step_status_type cpsst on cpsst.id = pps.company_process_step_status_type_id inner join flow.contact c on c.id = p.contact_id inner join flow.company_state cs on cs.id = p.company_state_id inner join flow.state s on s.id = cs.state_id inner join flow.custom_field cf on cf.id = e.resource_custom_field_id left join flow.user_position up on up.id = ppse.resource_id left join flow.user u on u.id = up.user_id left join flow.org o on o.id = ppse.resource_id inner join flow.company_system_list csl on csl.id = cf.company_system_list_id inner join flow.system_list sl on sl.id = csl.system_list_id where ppse.start_time is not null and ppse.end_time is not null and p.archived is false and ppse.resource_id is not null and case when :startTime::timestamp is not null and :endTime::timestamp is not null st.timestamp_value::timestamp end -- cancelled_date > start time means it was cancelled AFTER the appt and so we want to show it. cancelled_date < start time means cancelled before start time and dont want to show it ....right?? and (p.cancelled_date is null or p.cancelled_date >= st.timestamp_value::timestamp) --Only remove an appointment if the project was cancelled prior to the appointment start time (it currently pulls off all cancelled projects) and ppse.resource_id is not null and ppse.resource_id = any(array[ :combined ]::int[])

c.first_name as contact_first_name, c.last_name as contact_last_name, p.latitude, p.contact_id, p.longitude, case when sl.system_list_type_id = 1 then o.org_name else concat(u.first_name, ' ', inner join flow.process_step ps on ps.id = pps.process_step_id inner join flow.company_process_step_status_type cpsst on cpsst.id = pps.company_process_step_status_type_id inner join flow.contact c on c.id = p.contact_id inner join flow.company_state cs on cs.id = p.company_state_id inner join flow.state s on s.id = cs.state_id inner join flow.custom_field cf on cf.id = e.resource_custom_field_id sql.schedule.getProject: select cfg.group_name, pps.process_step_id, pps.project_id, ps.company_id, sl.id as system_list_id, array_to_json(resource_cf.system_list_option_ids) as system_list_option_ids, pps.id as project_process_step_id, sl.system_list_type_id, start_cfv.timestamp_value as start, start_cfv.id as start_custom_field_value_id, start_cfga.id as start_custom_field_group_assignment_id, start_cf.field_name as start_field_name, start_cf.readonly as start_field_read_only, end_cfv.timestamp_value as "end", end_cfv.id as end_custom_field_value_id, end_cfga.id as end_custom_field_group_assignment_id, end_cf.field_name as end_field_name, end_cf.readonly as end_field_read_only, resource_cfv.int_value as resource_id, resource_cfv.id as resource_custom_field_value_id, resource_cfga.id as resource_custom_field_group_assignment_id, resource_cf.field_name as resource_field_name, resource_cf.readonly as resource_field_read_only, c.first_name as contact_first_name, c.last_name as contact_last_name, p.latitude, p.longitude, p.street1, p.contact_id, p.city, p.postal_code, s.abbreviation as state_abbreviation, case when sl.system_list_type_id = 1 then o.org_name else concat(u.first_name, ' ', u.last_name) end as resource_name, p.project_name, ps.process_step_name, p.company_state_id, s.state, pps.company_process_step_status_type_id, cpsst.process_step_status_type, cpsst.process_step_status_type_id, case when sl.id is not null then coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(sys))) FROM ( select * from flow.get_system_list_options(ps.company_id::integer, sl.id::integer, true, resource_cf.system_list_option_ids::integer[]) ) sys), '[]') else '[]' end as resources from flow.project_process_step pps inner join flow.process_step ps on ps.id = pps.process_step_id inner join flow.custom_field_group cfg on cfg.process_step_id = pps.process_step_id inner join flow.company_process_step_status_type cpsst on cpsst.id = pps.company_process_step_status_type_id inner join flow.project p on p.id = pps.project_id inner join flow.contact c on c.id = p.contact_id inner join flow.company_state cs on cs.id = p.company_state_id inner join flow.state s on s.id = cs.state_id left join flow.custom_field_group_assignment start_cfga on start_cfga.custom_field_group_id = cfg.id and start_cfga.schedule_field_type_id = 1 left join flow.custom_field_group_assignment end_cfga on end_cfga.custom_field_group_id = cfg.id and flow.project_process_step_custom_field_value resource_cfv on resource_cfv.project_process_step_id = pps.id and resource_cfv.custom_field_group_assignment_id = resource_cfga.id left join flow.custom_field start_cf on start_cf.id = start_cfga.custom_field_id left join flow.custom_field end_cf on end_cf.id = end_cfga.custom_field_id left join flow.custom_field resource_cf on resource_cf.id = resource_cfga.custom_field_id left join flow.user_position up on up.id = resource_cfv.int_value left join flow.user u on u.id = up.user_id left join flow.org o on o.id = resource_cfv.int_value left join flow.company_system_list csl on csl.id = resource_cf.company_system_list_id left join flow.system_list sl on sl.id = csl.system_list_id where case when :isParent then ps.company_id = any (select id from flow.company_hierarchy_filter_down(:parentCompanyId::int)) else ps.company_id = :companyId end and ps.archived is not true and cfg.archived is not true and case when :projectProcessStepId::int is not null then pps.id = :projectProcessStepId::int and cfg.event_id is not null else 1=1 end and case when :projectId::int is not null then pps.project_id = :projectId::int else 1=1 end and case when :processStepStatusTypeId::int is null then 1=1 else cpsst.process_step_status_type_id = :processStepStatusTypeId::int end
sql.schedule.searchProjectsByName: select c.first_name as contact_first_name, c.last_name as contact_last_name, c.id as contact_id, concat(c.first_name, ' ', c.last_name) as contact_full_name, p.project_name, p.id as project_id from flow.project p inner join flow.contact c on c.id = p.contact_id where c.archived is not true and case when :isParent then c.company_id = any (select id from flow.company_hierarchy_filter_down(:parentCompanyId::int)) else c.company_id = :companyId end and (concat(c.first_name, ' ', c.last_name) ILIKE '%' || :search || '%' OR p.id::text = :search) order by c.first_name, c.last_name
